title: brainstorm
description: A divergent-exploration session captured as a durable, replayable record: a fuzzy area/goal plus the candidate ideas it produced, each scored by impact/effort/risk. The model authors it during a conversation (see the brainstorm skill) after exploring the codebase, the issue backlog, and run history; brainstorm.py consumes it — ranking the ideas into a shortlist and filing the human's picks as issues. The front door ABOVE spec-intake: ideas out, which then become standalone enhancement issues or feed spec-intake to become a full spec/batch.

area.description: the fuzzy area/goal the session explored (e.g. 'reduce batch-run cost')

ideas.description: the candidate ideas, in any order; brainstorm.py ranks them deterministically for the shortlist

title.description: the idea's name — becomes the issue title when filed

problem.description: the concrete gap/pain this idea addresses

proposal.description: the proposal sketch — how it would be addressed

effort.description: rough build cost (ranked ascending — cheaper first)

evidence.description: pointers that back the idea: file paths, issue refs, run-log observations
